text.description_html:
Global RDSUS26D-50PK, Bulk Pack Satin Chrome Baseboard Door Stops

Box of 50 - Perfect for high volume remodel or new construction Hotels, Office and Multi-Family Buildings. 3" length solid baseboard door stops will withstand many years of use. Standard commercial satin chrome finish.

Fast and Easy to Install - Slotted screw driver head is located under the rubbed tip so you can install with a drill. These commercial door stops screws onto the baseboard casement or door bottom.

Specifications of the RDSUS26D-50PK Bulk Pack Solid Baseboard Door Stop:

  • Length: 3"
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Bumper Color: White
  • Material: Pressure Cast Zinc
  • Comes packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

*Sold as Fifty Pack (50 each per box).
